assumptions.title_zh: 总体边界为临时粗略边界
assumptions.title_en: Overall boundary is a provisional rough constraint
assumptions.recalc_trigger: 取得资格预审/任务书官方红线后，替换 geometry/site_boundary.geojson 并重算 metrics.json 与全部依赖图层。

assumptions.title_zh: 三处重点区域为方向性占位
assumptions.title_en: Three key areas are directional placeholders
assumptions.recalc_trigger: 取得官方三区 polygon 后替换 geometry/key_areas.geojson，面积以公告为准（192.1/104.3/72.0 ha）。

assumptions.title_zh: 建筑层数与开发强度为假设
assumptions.title_en: Building floors and development intensity are assumed
assumptions.recalc_trigger: 取得现状建筑、容积率与控规条件后替换 buildings.geojson 并复算。

assumptions.title_zh: 道路面积为中心线缓冲近似
assumptions.title_en: Road area is a centerline-buffer approximation
assumptions.recalc_trigger: 取得道路红线与横断面后复算 road_area。
